about: The pages outside the shop, in the shop's look (tools/pages.py). cat: the shop category whose line colour the page takes and whose page its back link opens. mark: the dingbat beside the heading. stops: the picture under the heading, a job line like a card's (job: false leaves it off the page; the link card still draws it). glyphs: other dingbats the page draws (the 404's game). card: the link-preview picture tools/share_cards_pages.mjs draws (big, small, sub), one per language where the page has more than one. tools/dingbats.mjs bundles each page's glyphs as group p-<id>.
